name: Finders eat first
cost: everyone else loses 1 morale when they come home
narrator_line: Finders eat first. The shelter now has a class system.

name: Nobody opens the hatch
bonus: events can't give the hatch away
cost: no visitors, trades or favours at the door
narrator_line: The hatch is now a wall with ambitions.

name: Work or don't eat
narrator_line: Productivity is up. Nobody can say what is being produced.

name: The sick sleep upstairs
bonus: sickness can't spread or come back
cost: the sick lose 1 morale every night
narrator_line: Upstairs has a draft, a view, and very few visitors.

name: Kids eat last
bonus: a skipped child's ration only counts every other day
cost: children's morale stays at 5 or below
narrator_line: The children were not consulted. They noticed anyway.

name: Occupied homes are fair game
bonus: trips take 50% more from homes people still live in
cost: the explorer carries Guilt and the neighbourhood rescue is lost

name: The pet is an emergency ration
bonus: when the food runs out, the dog becomes 8 rations (the cat 4)
cost: everyone loses 3 morale when it happens
narrator_line: Nobody voted for it. Nobody voted against it either.
